categories.main_business_segments: Weiye Construction Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in building decoration design and construction, civil engineering construction, and related services. Its business includes public building decoration, residential fine decoration, curtain wall processing and installation, mechanical and electrical equipment installation, fire protection facilities, and building intelligence engineering. The company also engages in property leasing and management. It has subsidiaries specializing in various segments such as construction, decoration, technology, and design, forming a complete industrial chain from design to construction.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction and decoration technologies, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), digital and intelligent construction methods, and green building technologies. It integrates new materials, new technologies, and new processes to improve efficiency and quality. The company also focuses on photovoltaic building integration and energy-saving technologies aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals. Quality control follows national standards and ISO certifications, with strict safety and environmental management systems in place.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large real estate developers, government entities, and major corporations such as Huawei, Tencent, China Resources Land, and BYD. The company serves public buildings, commercial complexes, star-rated hotels, cultural and educational facilities, transportation infrastructure, and high-end residential projects. Its major markets are in the real estate and infrastructure sectors, with a strong focus on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, covering 28 provinces and cities nationwide. Its main revenue and projects are concentrated in South China, especially Guangdong Province, with additional presence in East China, Northeast, Northwest, North China, Central China, and Southwest regions. The headquarters is located in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Weiye Construction Group operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain. It undertakes construction and decoration projects, providing design, material procurement, and construction services directly to end customers. The company also engages in manufacturing of building materials such as doors, windows, and curtain walls through its technology subsidiary, integrating upstream material processing with downstream construction services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in green, intelligent, and digital construction technologies. It invests in R&D for new building materials, energy-saving products, and photovoltaic building integration. The strategic focus includes expanding core construction and decoration businesses, developing new energy and modern facility agriculture sectors, and enhancing digital and intelligent construction capabilities. The company also prioritizes improving project management, cost control, and sustainable development aligned with national policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through contract-based construction and decoration services, recognized based on contract performance and progress. The company also earns income from design services, product sales (e.g., building materials), and property leasing. Revenue recognition follows the percentage-of-completion method for construction contracts and point-in-time recognition for product sales. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to other revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Weiye Construction Group is a leading player in China's building decoration and civil engineering sectors, consistently ranked among the top 100 in the national building decoration industry for 22 years. It holds numerous high-level construction and decoration qualifications and has won prestigious awards such as the Luban Prize. The company benefits from strong brand recognition, extensive project experience, and backing by the state-owned Zhuhai Urban Construction Group, positioning it competitively against both large state-owned and private enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.77 billion, a 24.23% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 8.26 million, showing a slight increase. Total assets reached RMB 14.07 billion, up 7.19% year-over-year. Despite industry challenges, the company maintained a stable net profit and significantly improved operating cash flow. It managed over 476 projects nationwide and secured contracts worth about RMB 15.9 billion, indicating a solid operational scale and ongoing growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Weiye Construction Group differentiates itself through comprehensive qualifications, strong project management capabilities, and a complete industrial chain from design to construction. It emphasizes high-quality, green, and intelligent construction solutions, integrating advanced technologies like BIM and photovoltaic systems. The company leverages its state-owned background for financial stability and market trust, and maintains long-term partnerships with top-tier clients. Its commitment to quality, safety, and innovation positions it as a preferred partner in the construction and decoration industry.
